title: Medusa #1766: stringifyNullProperties crashes on null property values

error_signal.message: medusa-js TypeError: Cannot convert undefined or null to object in stringifyNullProperties when Object.keys is called on null value in utils

ground_truth.root_cause_description: stringifyNullProperties checks if value is an object before checking for null. Since typeof null === 'object', it passes the object check then crashes when Object.keys(null) is called.
ground_truth.fix_description: Check for null before the object type check
